response.sql: WITH customer_transactions AS (SELECT ft.transaction_amount, c.state_county_province FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id), state_totals AS (SELECT state_county_province, SUM(transaction_amount) as state_total FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY state_county_province), grand_total AS (SELECT SUM(state_total) as total FROM state_totals), state_shares AS (SELECT st.state_county_province, st.state_total, st.state_total / gt.total as share FROM state_totals st CROSS JOIN grand_total gt), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM state_shares), above_average_states AS (SELECT ss.state_total, ss.share, avg.avg_share FROM state_shares ss CROSS JOIN average_share avg WHERE ss.share > avg.avg_share) SELECT SUM(state_total) as combined_transaction_total, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as average_excess FROM above_average_states

assumptions.assumption: At least one transaction amount is non-NULL, ensuring grand_total is non-NULL and all share calculations are well-defined
